method: Primary Nikon S3300 reference-manual section retrieved by web search; separate from firmware static analysis and hardware observation
section: The Setup Menu / Welcome Screen / Reference E49

paraphrased_findings.None: Documented default; startup enters shooting or playback without a welcome screen.
paraphrased_findings.COOLPIX: Displays the stock welcome presentation before shooting or playback.
paraphrased_findings.Select an image: Stores a selected image for subsequent welcome display; the original photo can later be deleted. Some dimensions and small edited copies are excluded.

source_access_limit: Web search returned the relevant manual section; full PDF opening failed because its 14,040,819-byte content exceeded the web tool limit.
limitations: Documentation verifies intended stock behavior, not this camera's current setting or observed timing.
It does not establish the complete decoded-code control flow or the effect of a custom firmware patch.
